info.description:
Farm management multi-tenant API.
All responses follow a standard envelope (see Schemas).
info.title: Farm Deck API

post.description: Accepts the invitation token, creates the invitee's credential with the chosen password, activates their user account, and logs them in (auth cookies are set).
post.summary: Accept an invitation and set the account password

post.description: Revokes the current refresh token and clears auth cookies.
Uses the httpOnly refresh_token cookie to issue a new access token (and rotates the refresh token).

401.description: refresh token missing, invalid, or expired

post.description: Creates a new tenant and the first owner user, then sends a welcome email.
post.summary: Register a new user and tenant

get.description: Checks the raw invitation token from the email link and returns the invitee and tenant details so the accept-invite page can render. The token must be valid, unexpired, and not yet accepted or revoked.

parameters.description: Raw invitation token from the email link
parameters.name: token

400.description: token missing, invalid, expired, or revoked

get.description: Returns every farm belonging to the caller's tenant, along with active/inactive counts. Pass is_active to filter by active state; omit it to return all farms.

parameters.description: Filter by active state. Omit to return all farms (active and inactive).
parameters.name: is_active

post.description: Creates a farm owned by the caller's tenant. Authorization is gated by the farms.manage permission at the route level.

put.description: Updates the farm with the given id. Includes changing the farm type. Authorization is gated by the farms.manage permission and scoped to the caller's tenant.

400.description: invalid farm id or validation error

patch.description: Soft-deactivates the farm with the given id (sets is_active=false). Authorization is gated by the farms.manage permission and scoped to the caller's tenant.
Reactivates the farm with the given id (sets is_active=true). Authorization is gated by the farms.manage permission and scoped to the caller's tenant.

get.description: Returns the service status. Does not require authentication.
Returns the available farm (growing environment) types, e.g. indoor, outdoor, greenhouse, mixed.
Returns the available hydroponic system types, e.g. NFT, DWC, Ebb & Flow, aeroponics, drip, Kratky.
Returns the available soil types with their water retention and drainage characteristics, e.g. loamy, sandy, clay, silt, sandy loam, clay loam.
Returns the available zone (production area) types within a farm, e.g. soil plot, hydroponic system, aquaponic, mushroom room, along with their cultivation mode.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Returns all members of the caller's tenant except the caller (owner only), with status counts and last-active time.

post.description: Creates an invited user (owner only) and sends an invitation email with an accept-invite link.
post.summary: Invite a new member to the tenant

400.description: invalid member id or validation error

post.description: Creates a zone (field) on a farm owned by the caller's tenant. The zone type's cultivation mode drives which detail section is required — soil zones carry soil type details, hydro zones carry hydroponic system details. Authorization is gated by the fields.manage permission at the route level.
